In order for us to have bug reports in a form we can process efficiently please adhere to the following bug report template for all bugs you report on the forum.
Please note that all bug reports without the information requested in our template will most probably not be processed and therefore moved and/or closed.

Title: Please describe the bug briefly and put the category in front of the title.

Example: [Audio] Cannot hear “bug squashed” sounds.

Issue Description:

Please describe the actual issue in detail.

Example:
Whenever a character squashes an aggressive bug in a certain co-op campaign one doesn’t hear any squashing sound like the one used in other campaigns, e.g. all the single player ones.

Steps to reproduce:

If you know a way for us to reproduce the issue you just described please provide step-by-step instructions for us. Please also provide details on the region you chose (Europe or North America) during installation and the channel/room/map you joined (if you did).

Example:
Region: Europe
Channel: Battle-01-PL
Room: 5
Map: Bugs on Bricks
Mode: CTF

1. Enter the game, go to “Options” and double-check that volume is up and nothing has been muted.
2. Then do this.
3. Do that.
4. Eventually do this and voilà, the bug is at your feet!

Expected Behavior:

Please tell us what you’d expect this aspect of the game to behave like if it was working as intended.

Example: Every time I squash a bug, the appropriate sound file should be triggered so I can hear the that squashing sound.

Version:

If you found a game-related bug please provide the game’s version shown on top of the log-in screen.

Example:

Brick-Force v1.4.40 (Brick-Force 1.4 with Infernum Build 40)
If you found an issue related to the game’s security software please also provide the version of that software, e.g. X-Trap v3623.

Attachments:

Often a screenshot can better describe what the actual problem is so feel free to attach one (please reduce size and convert to JPG before).
If however you run into a problem of technical nature an attached dxdiag.txt is often helpful.
You don’t want to make certain information available to everyone in a public forum? Feel free to report to our Customer Support instead: support.infernum.com

Bug Reports not using the template will most probably not make their way to the Quality Assurance department so please remember to use the template and fill it with all the valuable information you have at your hands!
Should be common sense but what goes for the other forum areas is also valid here: Please respect the forum rules and be nice.
Last but not least, we’d like to thank you for your invaluable help so we can make Brick-Force the best experience we could hope for!

Thank you very much.

Your Brick-Force Team

This had been working fine for a while now, but then today, I tried to launch BF from Steam and I got an error from XTrap saying that the SteamOverlayUI.dll is corrupted. What has changed?

I'm just making an educated guess, but it might have been the Steam client update that was pushed out yesterday.

The Steam overlay injects itself into the game executable and draws the overlay on top of it when you press Shift-Tab. Obviously X-Trap doesn't like things injecting into the game, but it probably had the signature of the Steam overlay whitelisted - until the Steam update changed that signature.
